async def entry(x, y):
    open_slot("outer")
    try:
        open_slot("inner")
        try:
            if probe("left", x) and probe("right", y):
                emit("selected")
                return stage("handle")
            emit("fallback")
            fail("primary")
        finally:
            close_slot("inner")
    finally:
        close_slot("outer")
